post.description: Waits for a button held on the speaker. The speaker downloads the newest stable Core release that is newer than the running one and streams it into the same install as POST /api/firmware?install=1, signature and version checks included. confirm must be true. The answer is the install's report; reboot to start the new slot. 200 with status current when no newer release exists.

put.description: Waits for a key held on the speaker. key is the base64 of the 32 raw bytes of an ed25519 public key. It is kept in both copies of the U-Boot environment, so the USB-stick recovery trusts it too.

501.description: This speaker has no U-Boot environment to keep a key in.

delete.description: Waits for a key held on the speaker. Afterwards only the release keys are trusted. A factory reset removes it as well.

Error.description: Error: 4xx is the caller's fault, 5xx the speaker's.

Request.name: X-SoundTap-Request
Request.description: Optional id naming one user action. A repeated write with the same id within a minute gets the first answer back instead of acting twice.

error.description: What went wrong, in English, for a person. Its wording may change in any release.

code.description: What went wrong, for a program: stable across releases, so a client says it in its own language. The list is open: treat a code you do not know as the generic failure the status says.

Error.description: The one error shape. Status says whose fault: 4xx the caller's, 5xx the speaker's. code says what went wrong: invalid_request (400), not_found (404), method_not_allowed (405), forbidden (403), signature_invalid (403, an upload's signature is missing or does not verify), confirm_required (428, or 400 for an app upload, the X-SoundTap-Confirm it needs), not_confirmed (403, nobody held a button on the speaker in time), confirm_superseded (409, a newer request took this one's place in the wait for the button), busy (409 or 503, another operation is running), conflict (409, the speaker's state does not allow it), timeout (408, 504), too_large (413), package_rejected (400, 415), precondition_failed (412), unsupported (501), unavailable (503), clock_not_set (503, the update check waits until NTP has set the clock since boot), upstream_failed (502), storage_full (507), internal (500).

stationId.description: A TuneIn guide id, or an http(s) stream URL of the user's own.

endsAt.description: RFC 3339; empty when no timer runs.

auxName.description: What the AUX input is called where it plays; empty is AUX.

crashReports.description: Turns the crash report offer on or off (ADR 0126).

SettingsPatch.description: Every field is optional: what is absent keeps its stored value.

id.description: The speaker's identity: its factory serial, else deviceId.

os.description: SoundTap Core version; empty off a speaker.

commit.description: Commit the image was built from; empty off a speaker.

capabilities.description: What this speaker has: bluetooth (an adapter is present), ir, keypad, aux, display, battery. An open list: ignore values you do not know.

Boot.description: The running boot, for bench scripts without a shell (tools/hil/, ADR 0119).

id.description: The kernel's boot_id: every boot has a new one. Empty where the kernel has none.

slot.description: The NAND slot this boot runs from, PING or PONG; empty off NAND.

confirmed.description: soundtapd has confirmed this boot to U-Boot's boot count (ADR 0010), a minute after it started.

previous.description: How the boot before this one ended, as ramoops recorded it (reboot, power loss, panic, ...); empty when nothing was recorded.

bootloader.description: The SPL and U-Boot on NAND by SHA-256, each image as long as its header says: the sums of a build's MLO and u-boot.img. Read once per soundtapd start; absent off NAND. A copy that cannot be read or does not parse is empty.

uboot.description: The first U-Boot copy in mtd4.

ubootSpare.description: The spare U-Boot copy at mtd4+0x100000.

unavailable.description: Set when the release list could not be reached; stable is then null.

unavailableCode.description: Why, with unavailable: clock_not_set while NTP has not set the speaker's clock since boot (the speaker does not ask GitHub before), upstream_failed when GitHub did not answer.

core.description: Absent from speakers that predate the Core lane.

location.description: The content location; absent for sources that cannot be replayed.

canSkip.description: Next and previous work through the transport keys.

failed.description: This selection ended without ever playing.

stationId.description: A TuneIn guide id, or an http(s) stream URL of the user's own.

location.description: Empty when the entry cannot be replayed.

deviceId.description: The same speaker as /api/devices calls it; absent for a client that is not a SoundTap speaker.

lastSeenAgo.description: Seconds since an offline client was last seen.

bootloaders.description: The boot chain copies the install rewrote (mtd1, mtd4+0x100000, ...); absent when the speaker already held the package's.

version.description: What the signature says the package is; stock for the stock firmware.

confirm.description: The X-SoundTap-Confirm an install of it needs here.

brightness.description: Clock peak in percent; absent is the default.

name.description: Absent when the speaker could not be asked.

model.description: Absent when the speaker could not be asked.

soundbar.description: Soundbars only; null until the processor has answered.

crashReports.description: Whether the web UI offers to report a crash it finds on the speaker (ADR 0126); off by default.

CoreReleases.description: SoundTap Core: the running version and, on a speaker, the newest stable Core release when it is newer. POST /api/core-update installs it.

current.description: The running Core version; empty off a speaker.

Health.description: The resources that, when they run out, stop the speaker from updating or staying up, and whether a production image's inbound filter is loaded. Warnings are computed on the speaker, so the UI and the support bundle agree. boot is the running boot, read by the bench scripts in tools/hil/.

processes.description: 0 when the speaker could not count them.

battery.description: The SoundTouch Portable's battery pack and charger; absent on every other model.

bco.description: The SoundTouch 20's network card (ADR 0031): the BCO app's transmit and link counters, which count from the BCO app's start in 32 bits and wrap, and whether the driver holds Wi-Fi frames in its queue for want of a free BCO transmit buffer. Absent on every other model and with a BCO app without counters.

txFailed.description: Frames lost on air after the retries.

txDropped.description: Frames the BCO never sent: no free transmit buffer, or not joined.

linkDropped.description: Messages the BCO dropped at the USB link, on any channel.

txFrames.description: Frames from the speaker the radio took.

flowControl.description: The driver counts the BCO's free transmit buffers and holds frames while there are none.

flowStops.description: Times the driver held a Wi-Fi queue for want of a free buffer.

firewall.description: The production inbound filter (ADR 0066): loaded; missing, on a production image whose filter did not load, so every listening port is open (a warning says so too); n/a on an alpha image, which loads none, and off a speaker. Checked at most once a minute by a bounded, read-only nft run.

counters.description: Restarts, underruns and failed writes, counted in memory since soundtapd started (sinceSeconds ago); soundtapdRestarts alone spans soundtapd's restarts and counts this boot (ADR 0127).

soundtapdRestarts.description: How often the init script started soundtapd again in this boot.

daemonRestarts.description: Per supervised media daemon, the restarts after it exited on its own or failed to start; a deliberate stop is not one.

bufferUnderruns.description: Times the mixer's jitter buffer ran dry while a source played.

alsaUnderruns.description: Underruns aplay reported: the sound card ran out of samples.

installFailures.description: Firmware installs that were admitted and then failed.

bcoFlashFailures.description: Failed flashes of the ST20's BCO image; 0 on other models.

bootConfirmRetries.description: Looks of the boot confirmation that found the boot not good yet (ADR 0010).

available.description: The speaker has an environment the key can be kept in.

active.description: An owner key is set and trusted.

key.description: The public key, base64 of its 32 raw bytes.

fingerprint.description: The first 8 bytes of the key's SHA-256, in hex.

CrashReport.description: A crash written up as a GitHub issue the owner opens and submits: the exact title and body the link carries, already redacted as the support bundle is. Nothing is sent by the speaker.

id.description: The crash's kind and a hash of its content, e.g. panic-0123456789ab.

kind.description: panic: soundtapd's last panic (panic.log); kernel: the previous boot ended in a kernel panic or oops; daemon: a media daemon crash-looped.

body.description: Markdown: what happened, the versions, the model, the uptime, the trace as far as the link has room, and a request to attach the support bundle.

url.description: https://github.com/stein155/soundtap/issues/new with title and body, at most 6000 bytes.

enabled.description: Whether the owner turned crash reports on.

crash.description: The first crash on the speaker not yet reported or dismissed; null when there is none, and always while reports are off.
